research_question: Why did primitive-only adaptation transfer negatively to the fully held-out URL scheme-downgrade family, and can a zero-parameter semantic episode rule repair it without hiding neural negative transfer?

audit_before_intervention.existing_projection: routed URL text already serializes scheme|hostname|path in one token; explicit port is omitted
audit_before_intervention.confirmed_gap: episode Rule Memory induces suffix predicates from raw URL text but cannot induce hostname equality from parsed observations
audit_before_intervention.interpretation: representation is partially structured; both rule induction and neural checkpoint behavior must be measured separately

hypotheses.H1_suffix_is_primary: C2 minus C1 is at least +10pp on every seed
hypotheses.H2_structured_rule_repairs_system: C4 reaches at least 90% on every seed with complete target-family holdout
hypotheses.H3_arbitration_is_causal: C4 exceeds C3 by at least +5pp on mean
hypotheses.H4_neural_negative_transfer_remains: the neural-with-memory path of adapted checkpoints remains below the frozen path even if C4 repairs the combined system

decision_policy.architecture_fix: Accept C4 only if all three target scores are at least 90%, all regression families remain within -2pp, and no target-family labels or names enter the rule inducer.
decision_policy.neural_claim: Do not describe a C4 gain as neural generalization; report it as zero-parameter architecture/rule-abstraction repair.
decision_policy.training: Do not retrain or scale the model in this loop unless the zero-parameter ablation fails.
decision_policy.next_step_if_repaired: Create detached scheme, hostname and effective-port primitive families for a later neural distillation loop while retaining the C4 rule path as teacher evidence.
